verdict: Meta leads are surging; Google's spend needs an urgent fix.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 31 leads at an average cost of $128.26 per lead — all 31 came from Meta, where your cost per lead was $52.21. Google Ads consumed $2,357.56 of your budget and produced 1 conversion, a gap that is the top priority this period. We are reviewing the targeting and creative on Google's top search campaign immediately to either recover efficiency or reallocate that spend. Separately, your Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply this week, and we are investigating to restore that organic call volume. On the pipeline side, leads are arriving but not yet converting to booked consultations, so we are working with you on the intake process to close that gap next period.
